g.text: Coach to bogie: bolted adapter, centre bearing and side bearers
CI1-D02 · CI1-R0 · Current coach installation · nominal mm · 20 October 2026
Exploded connection detail · body-side pieces lifted for visibility
Body connection: four M16 bolts through Ø26 / Ø18 sleeves, 304.8 long, into an 18 mm adapter.
Bolt centres: X ±18, Y ±160 relative to pivot. Adapter footprint: 280 ×440.
Compression support: upper spherical insert → bronze liner → lower cup → bogie crossbeam.
Side bearers at Y ±500 steady the body and allow sliding as the bogie turns.
Separate Ø50 kingpin, lower washer, locknut and cross-keeper retain the body against uplift.
The kingpin is not the normal vertical compression support. Welds, sleeve joints and retention strength require review.
Connection study from existing C5/CW3/C56 geometry. Welds, fasteners, springs and complete load qualification remain open.
No fabrication release. Exploded separation explains parts; it is not a lifting or dismantling procedure.
